title: How to Use Quizzes in Thrive Apprentice

sections.heading: Using the "Mark as Complete" Feature on a Quiz

steps.raw_text: Navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice** and open the course you want to edit.
steps.context: > Thrive Apprentice and open the course you want to edit

steps.raw_text: Select the lesson that contains your quiz.
Open the lesson settings and locate the **Completion** section.
Set the **Mark as Complete** behavior to require quiz completion.
Save your changes.

sections.heading: Enabling "Mark as Complete" Only After the User Passes the Quiz

steps.raw_text: Navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice** and open your course.
steps.context: > Thrive Apprentice and open your course

steps.raw_text: Select the lesson with the quiz.
In the lesson's **Completion** settings, set the behavior to **Quiz must be passed**.
steps.context: settings, set the behavior to Quiz must be passed

steps.raw_text: Define the passing score threshold in Thrive Quiz Builder (e.g., 70% or higher).
Save your settings.

sections.heading: Unlocking the Next Lesson Only After a Student Passes the Quiz

steps.raw_text: Navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice** and open your course.
steps.context: > Thrive Apprentice and open your course

steps.raw_text: Go to **Courses** in the sidebar and select your course.
Add your quiz to the lesson content using Thrive Quiz Builder.
Open the **Drip** settings for the course.
Create a new **Drip Schedule** and set the unlock condition to **After previous lesson is completed**.
steps.context: and set the unlock condition to After previous lesson is completed

steps.raw_text: Link the drip schedule to your course's product under the **Access Restrictions** settings.
Save and publish.

sections.heading: Enrolling Users in a Course After They Complete a Quiz

steps.raw_text: Create your quiz in Thrive Quiz Builder and add a **WordPress account connection** to the quiz's opt-in gate. This ensures quiz takers are registered as WordPress users.
steps.context: quiz's opt-in gate. This ensures quiz takers are registered as WordPress users

steps.raw_text: Go to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Automator** and click **+ Add New**.
steps.context: > Thrive Automator and click + Add New

steps.raw_text: Set the **Start Trigger** to **User completes quiz**.
Select the specific quiz from the dropdown.
Add an **Action** and select **Grant access to product**.
steps.context: and select Grant access to product

steps.raw_text: Choose the Thrive Apprentice product that contains the course you want to enroll them in.
Click **Save and Activate**.

sections.heading: Unlocking Lesson Content After Students Pass the Final Exam

steps.raw_text: Create the final exam quiz in Thrive Quiz Builder with a defined passing score.

sections.heading: Changing the "Mark Lesson as Complete" Notification Message

steps.raw_text: Navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice**.
Open the course and select the lesson whose notification you want to change.
Go to the lesson's **Completion** settings.
Locate the **Notification Message** field.
Edit the text to display your preferred message. For example, you might change it from the default to something like "Great job! You've passed the quiz. Click below to continue to the next lesson."
steps.target: Great job! You've passed the quiz. Click below to continue to the next lesson.

steps.raw_text: Save your changes.
